rows.title: Kimpton Las Mercedes Santo Domingo
rows.body:
Urban, Dominican Republic, CALA, Colonial City, Lifestyle boutique

Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic (Colonial City / Zona Colonial)

Historic conversion · lifestyle boutique · restaurant-forward urban

DR debut · colonial-zone lifestyle

Kimpton Las Mercedes opened in 2024 in Santo Domingo's Colonial City—130 rooms in a revitalized 16th-century complex with rooftop pool, courtyard, and Iberostar-operated F&B.

Colonial-zone lifestyle hotels reward authentic public spaces and operator F&B discipline—confirm fees, incentives, and conversion PIP before you model from U.S. gateway prototypes.

https://www.ihg.com/kimptonhotels/hotels/us/en/las-mercedes-santo-domingo/sdqlm/hoteldetail
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Santo Domingo Colonial City: Kimpton Las Mercedes—2024 opening in a historic urban core, 130 rooms with rooftop and courtyard lifestyle product.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Capture urban leisure and regional transient demand with design-led boutique positioning and restaurant-forward social spaces.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Reference for CALA historic urban conversion versus Mexico resort or Honduras beach repositioning.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Colonial-city assets need F&B and design capex matched to local ADR—do not assume U.S. urban Kimpton ramp from one opening headline.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Dominican Republic, CALA, Urban, Colonial City, Lifestyle, Kimpton

rows.title: Kimpton Virgilio
rows.body:
Urban, Mexico, CALA, Polanco, Lifestyle boutique

Mexico City, Mexico (Polanquito / Polanco)

Adaptive reuse · 48-room boutique · restaurant-forward

Mexico City debut · Polanquito lifestyle

Kimpton Virgilio debuted in February 2024 as Kimpton's first boutique hotel in Mexico City—a converted 1940s residential building with Pepe: Mesa Española restaurant and rooftop pool.

Gateway urban Kimpton needs operator strength on F&B and design QA—confirm IHG fee stack and loyalty contribution in your market comp set.

https://www.kimptonhotels.com/stay/kimpton-virgilio
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Mexico City Polanquito: Kimpton Virgilio—February 2024 opening, 48-room adaptive-reuse boutique with Spanish-influenced dining.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Win design-conscious urban transient and short-stay demand with boutique scale and IHG One Rewards distribution.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Urban Mexico reference versus Baja resort or Caribbean beach repositioning plays.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Small-key boutiques live on ADR and F&B margin—match Polanco-style demand and operator capability to your building before signing.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Mexico, CALA, Mexico City, Urban, Lifestyle, Kimpton

rows.title: Kimpton Mas Olas Resort & Spa
rows.body:
Resort, Mexico, CALA, Baja Sur, Beachfront lifestyle

Todos Santos, Baja California Sur, Mexico (Pacific coast)

Resort lifestyle · adults-oriented · spa and F&B forward

Baja Pacific debut · wellness-led leisure

Kimpton Mas Olas opened April 2024 on Baja Sur's Pacific coast—103 rooms including oceanfront villas, Botánica Spa, and desert-to-ocean positioning an hour from Cabo.

Baja Pacific resorts swing on leisure seasonality and F&B staffing—budget wellness and dining for peak and shoulder months, not only opening photos.

https://www.masolasresort.com/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Todos Santos, Baja Sur: Kimpton Mas Olas—April 2024 resort opening with spa-forward lifestyle product on the Pacific.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Monetize leisure compression with design-led resort public spaces and wellness-led guest experience.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Resort CALA reference versus Mexico City urban boutique or Caribbean conversion economics.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Pacific Baja leisure is seasonal—confirm operator F&B capability and IHG program fees before you underwrite from one resort headline.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Mexico, CALA, Baja Sur, Resort, Beachfront, Kimpton

rows.title: Kimpton Grand Roatán Resort & Spa
rows.body:
Resort, Honduras, CALA, Western Caribbean, Beach repositioning

Roatán, Bay Islands, Honduras (West Bay Beach)

Conversion repositioning · 119 keys · reef-access leisure

Island debut · Western Caribbean leisure

Kimpton Grand Roatán opened October 2023 on West Bay Beach—the first internationally branded resort on Roatán, with four F&B outlets and Kao Kamasa spa.

Island resort economics depend on air access and leisure seasonality—model fees and ramp from local comp set, not mainland gateway averages.

https://www.kimptongrandroatan.com/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Roatán, Honduras: Kimpton Grand Roatán—October 2023 opening, first international branded resort on the island, reef-adjacent leisure.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Capture Western Caribbean leisure with upper-upscale resort F&B, spa, and lifestyle service standards.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Caribbean conversion/repositioning reference versus Mexico urban or Dominican historic urban plays.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Roatán rewards resort operators who can fill air-lift leisure—confirm conversion PIP and IHG loyalty mix for your underwriting.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Honduras, CALA, Caribbean, Resort, Repositioning, Kimpton

rows.title: Kimpton Seafire Resort + Spa
rows.body:
Resort, Cayman Islands, CALA, Seven Mile Beach, Flagship Caribbean

Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands (Seven Mile Beach)

New-build resort · 266 rooms · spa and signature F&B

Caribbean flagship · Seven Mile Beach leisure

Kimpton Seafire on Seven Mile Beach is Kimpton's flagship Caribbean resort—opened 2016 as Grand Cayman's first major new resort in more than a decade, with spa and multiple dining venues.

Seven Mile Beach competes on leisure retail and fee stack—use local comps and operator track record before you assume Seafire-scale economics on a smaller parcel.

https://www.seafireresortandspa.com/
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Grand Cayman: Kimpton Seafire—flagship Caribbean resort on Seven Mile Beach, large-key lifestyle with spa and signature dining.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Serve premium leisure and group demand with resort-scale lifestyle product and IHG distribution.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Established CALA resort anchor versus newer Mexico and Dominican urban openings.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Flagship resort Kimpton requires sustained F&B, spa, and design investment—match operator and capex to your asset, not Seafire's scale alone.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Cayman Islands, CALA, Caribbean, Resort, Seven Mile Beach, Kimpton
